title: reSIProcate reTurn client through 1.14.0 contains a heap buffer overflow in TurnTcpSocket::handleReadHeader() that…
description: A heap buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the reSIProcate reTurn client through version 1.14.0 in the TurnTcpSocket::handleReadHeader() function. This flaw allows malicious TURN servers to send STUN or ChannelData frames with oversized declared lengths, causing memory overwrite beyond the fixed buffer size and leading to client crashes.
